lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Parallel horizontal rows of discrete, circular high-luminance pixel clusters extending from the posterior gill region across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like configuration across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of roughly 5 to 8 high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
